title: Manifest
description: Repository memory manifest tracking git state and sync metadata.

schema_version.description: Schema version of the manifest format.

memory_version.description: Monotonically increasing version counter for memory state.

git.description: Git repository state at last sync.

available.description: Whether git is available in the repository.

has_commits.description: Whether the repository has any commits.

head.description: Current HEAD commit hash, or null if no commits.

last_synced_commit.description: Commit hash at last successful sync, or null if never synced.

worktree_state.description: Working tree state: clean, dirty, or unknown.

last_sync.description: Metadata from the last sync operation, or null if never synced.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot ID used for the sync.
